events.title: Iran War Escalation
events.summary: The Iran war has escalated, with the US showcasing its military strength but also its waning geopolitical power. The conflict has significant implications for global markets and economies. Geopolitical instability in the Middle East is on the rise.
events.reasoning: The escalation of the Iran war will likely lead to increased demand for defense and aerospace products, benefiting the iShares MSCI Aerospace & Defense ETF. On the other hand, the conflict may disrupt oil supplies, negatively impacting the VanEck Vectors Oil Services ETF.
events.exitStrategy: Exit when a ceasefire is announced or when the conflict de-escalates
otherFactors: Geopolitical instability in the Middle East

events.title: Federal Reserve Interest Rate Decision

events.reasoning: A modest interest rate increase will likely boost the US economy, benefiting the SPDR S&P 500 ETF Trust. On the other hand, higher interest rates may negatively impact long-term Treasury bonds, affecting the iShares 20+ Year Treasury Bond ETF.
events.exitStrategy: Exit when the interest rate decision is announced

gains.conservativeNote: If the interest rate increase is modest
gains.extendedNote: If the interest rate increase is higher than expected
